events.label: Roy wakes 07:00; apartment assassins
events.description: Roy wakes at seven in the morning to assassins storming his apartment - the opening of a day he will live and die more than a hundred times.

events.label: Helicopter gunner; building explodes
events.description: A helicopter gunship tears into the building and blows it apart - one of the many ways the day ends for him.

events.label: Dies ~12:47 — hard fail learned over ~140 loops
events.description: No matter what he does, Roy dies at 12:47 - the day's hard limit, learned across roughly a hundred and forty repeats.

events.label: Osiris Spindle resets Roy to morning
events.description: Death returns him to the same morning. The machine responsible - the Osiris Spindle - holds him in the repeating day.

events.label: Bonds with son Joe at gaming tournament
events.description: Between deaths, Roy bonds with his son Joe at a gaming tournament - relearning how to be a father he barely was.

events.label: Dies protecting Joe; reveals he is father
events.description: Roy dies shielding Joe, finally telling him the truth: he is his father, and he loves him.

events.label: Removes Alice tracker across trial loops
events.description: Across the loops, Roy works out how to remove the tracker that keeps finding him - one solved problem at a time.

events.label: Ventor: Spindle is quantum history rewriter; killed Jemma
events.description: Ventor, the scientist behind the Spindle, reveals what it is - a machine that rewrites history - and that he killed Jemma, Roy's ex-wife, to build it.

events.label: Trains sword work with Dai Feng loop-by-loop
events.description: Loop by loop, Roy trains swordsmanship with master Dai Feng, arriving at the same lesson hundreds of times until he perfects it.

events.label: Kills Ventor but Joe dies; Spindle apocalypse
events.description: Roy finally kills Ventor - and Joe dies and the Spindle melts the world down: the one perfect-seeming loop that ends in apocalypse.

events.label: Jemma phoned Joe after supposed murder — still alive AM
events.description: A phone call proves Jemma alive after her supposed murder - the loop's timeline is not what Roy was told.

events.label: Chopper speedrun; save Jemma in 14 minutes
events.description: Roy speedruns the day: helicopter hijack, rescue of Jemma in fourteen minutes flat, every hard-earned skill spent at once.

events.label: Roy enters Spindle to reset — ambiguous continue
events.description: Roy walks into the Spindle to reset everything one last time - and the film leaves him mid-loop, still fighting.

events.label: Alt ending: faces morning attacker — 'Piece o cake'
events.description: In the alternate ending, he wakes to the morning's first assassin and takes it in stride: piece of cake.

events.label: Roy wakes to assassination day
events.description: Roy wakes into the same assassination morning again.

events.label: Jemma / Guanite weapon plot
events.description: Jemma's thread: her secret weapon work, and the Guanite plot around it.

events.label: Son stakes
events.description: Joe is the day's true stake - the son Roy keeps failing and finally learns to save.

events.label: Attributes gains across deaths
events.description: Each death is a lesson: skills banked across loops turn Roy into the man who can survive the day.

events.label: Escape loop confrontation
events.description: The final confrontation, where everything learned across the loops is cashed in.

events.label: Death resets day
events.description: The rule of the day: die, and it starts again at seven.

events.label: Private army assaults
events.description: A private army storms the day again and again - the same battle fought to perfection over many resets.

events.label: Family aftermath
events.description: After the loop, family - the aftermath the film has been earning.

ruleEffects.effect: True win condition is save Jemma early, not kill Ventor late
Each death rewinds to 07:00 with retained skill/memory

outcome.summary: Roy learns the speedrun; enters Spindle for reset with ambiguous continue endings.
